label: Starter, new Noto mesh with free reverse afterslip, 30 km BEL, UNR positions (exploratory MCMC)
description: starter_jt10_unr with an updated mesh set (the Noto-Niigata mesh reaches 25 km instead of 15 km; the BEL sheet is at 30 km instead of 50 km). After the 2024 Noto earthquake the Noto-Niigata mesh slips freely in reverse dip-slip only (prior sigma 200 mm/yr Jan-Mar 2024, 100 mm/yr after), with its strike-slip held to coupling [-10, 1]: UNR IGS20 positions, same 596 GEONET sites and windows
attribution: GNSS: GEONET daily positions, Geospatial Information Authority of Japan (GSI).
Coastline: Global Map Japan, Geospatial Information Authority of Japan (地球地図日本・国土地理院).
Earthquakes: Global CMT catalog (Dziewonski et al., 1981; Ekström et al., 2012).
